Ten games, just open one

Ten free browser games on JoyFlock: Flight Party, Pool, Nine-ball, Snooker, Gomoku, Chess, Connect Four, Tic-Tac-Toe, Cards and Bubble Shooter. No download, no sign-up, with computer and friend-room play.

Open the game lobby ↗

Pick a game

  • Nine-ball2 players · A casual nine-ball table: hit the lowest ball first, then pot the 9 to win.
  • Pool2 players · A casual 8-ball table that takes three moves: aim, pull back, release.
  • Flight Party2–4 players · Roll, launch, jump and bump. Two to four seats, and a bot keeps your planes moving if you drop out.
  • Connect Four2 players · Seven columns, one drop per turn, four in a row wins — a match lasts a couple of minutes.
  • Gomoku2 players · Free-style rules: alternate black and white, first to five in a row wins.
  • Chess2 players · Full standard rules — castling, en passant and promotion — with simple click-to-move controls.
  • Tic-tac-toe2 players · A 3×3 grid and a one-second rulebook — perfect for a quick match while you wait.
  • Cards2 players · Seven cards each; match a colour or a number and be first to empty your hand.
  • Snooker2 players · Reds and colours in turn, then clear by value — a longer table that rewards position play.
  • Bubble Shooter2 players · Every pop or dropped cluster pushes the opponent down; first field to the bottom line loses.
